venture.display_name: Proposed vintage inspired graphic tee brand
venture.business_concept: New graphic T-shirts with a faded vintage look at an affordable price.
venture.target_customers: Creative, fashion-conscious young men, including college students with limited access to suitable thrift stores.
venture.customer_need: Find attractive, good-quality vintage-looking tees without damage, high resale prices, or hours of searching.
venture.value_proposition: Affordable vintage graphics, a recognizable brand identity, and a distinctive website.
venture.research_market_assumption: United States online retail, USD. The venture document does not specify geography.
distribution_channels: Own website is implied by the venture document; other channels are unspecified.
features: Good quality and intact condition are desired benefits

competitors.name: Abercrombie & Fitch
competitors.geographic_market: U.S. storefront used; broader international retailer
competitors.target_customers: Style-conscious men seeking casual fashion and nostalgic graphics (analyst interpretation).
competitors.main_products: Casual apparel, vintage inspired graphic tees and heavyweight graphic collections.
competitors.positioning: Upper end of this sample at full price; clearance creates lower entry prices (analyst interpretation).
competitors.relevance: Offers new vintage inspired tees online, directly addressing the desired look without a thrift search.

competitors.name: Hollister
competitors.geographic_market: U.S. storefront used; broader international retailer
competitors.target_customers: Younger casual-fashion shoppers and car-graphic fans (analyst interpretation).
competitors.main_products: Casual apparel, boxy graphic tees and licensed car and entertainment designs.
competitors.positioning: Value to mid-market in this sample, with a promotional entry price (analyst interpretation).
competitors.relevance: Offers accessible new graphic tees in fits and themes relevant to young men.

competitors.name: Urban Outfitters
competitors.geographic_market: U.S. storefront used; broader international retailer
competitors.target_customers: Fashion-oriented men seeking music, movie and automotive graphic tees (analyst interpretation).
competitors.main_products: Multi-brand fashion and graphic tees with music, film and racing themes.
competitors.positioning: Mid to upper end of this sample, emphasizing themed graphics and vintage styling (analyst interpretation).
competitors.relevance: Explicitly markets modern reprints and retro styling as an alternative to hunting for vintage.

comparison.unit: per new short-sleeve graphic tee before tax and shipping

representative.basis: One selected offer per competitor at its current product-page listed price. Includes Hollister promotion; excludes clearance P02.

representative_reference_price.basis: Displayed non-marked/reference prices of the same three representatives. A context comparison, not historical realized prices.

all_offers.basis: All seven selected current offers, including clearance. Not equally weighted by competitor; do not use as a market average.

preliminary_recommendation.unit: per tee before tax and shipping
preliminary_recommendation.rationale: Below the $34.95–$45 standard/reference benchmarks in this sample, but above Hollister’s $20.97 promotion and Abercrombie’s $22.99 clearance. The range requires distinctive original graphics, consistent fit, a convincing faded finish and documented quality.

proposed_bundle.status: Hypothesis requiring margin validation; not a competitor offer

research_limitations: The venture name and launch geography are unspecified. U.S. online retail in USD is an explicit research assumption.

Three retail brands and seven selected offers are a purposive sample, not a market census. All three are direct alternatives; genuine vintage resale and local thrift shops remain indirect competition without comparable standardized offers in this dataset.
Abercrombie and Hollister appear together in Abercrombie’s Our Brands footer. Treat them as separate shopping alternatives, not three independent corporate pricing observations.

Prices were checked October 27, 2026. Web extractions can reflect cached pages; browser checks resolved Hollister localization and confirmed Abercrombie P01 and Urban Outfitters P05. This is not a checkout or inventory audit.
Urban Outfitters Toyota category price of $27.30 conflicts with its $39 product page. The product-page value is used; a live cart would be needed to resolve the payable price.
Displayed reference prices are not evidence that customers previously paid them. Clearance and selected promotional offers may have limited duration, color or size availability.
Comparisons exclude sales tax, shipping, returns, loyalty, basket discounts and installment financing. No exchange-rate normalization is used.
Product quality, shrinkage, print durability, willingness to pay, demand, unit costs, licensing costs and profit margins have not been tested. Cotton content alone does not establish quality.
Target-customer and positioning descriptions are analyst interpretations of assortment and pricing. Market opportunities are hypotheses, not proven unmet demand.
No customization, subscription, free trial or relevant per-item bundle was established for the sampled offers. Null denotes unknown or not established, never a zero price.
